original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: Changed residual subproblem on the open PR3148 T740 fill of PR3133's words: PR3200's idle-donor construction with phase 1 replaced by an exact memoised per-(replica, port) search over legal PR1252-rule hosted-remainder donor moves (cap 51), each choice scored by the group's final cost after optional PR3184 stars and PR3200's unchanged phase 3, composed with the R438 bit supplier (research/r438-native-rehost).
scope_change_reason: PR3200 left the complex side binding 3.9e-8 below the R438 bit endpoint with a greedy phase 1; an exact per-group search scored jointly with phases 2 and 3 closes about 22% of that window.
bottleneck_link: kappa = min(complex, bit); the complex side binds, and more idle repartition lowers its moment cost.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact overlay, pricing and independent verifier; no controller/outer admission.
evidence: RESULT.json, BINS.json.gz, MOVES.json.gz (435,604 axis moves), AUDIT.json (8/8 controls rejected), R438 endpoint re-derived; PR3200's unmodified verify.py also passes.
author: Rohan Arun
ai_assistance: Substantial Anthropic Claude (Claude Code) assistance; done with help from OpenCode (Space bunny free).

open_questions.question: Do hosted donors and multi-donor receivers satisfy the T74 controller contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only PR1252 unhosted pairs have an admitted controller audit.
open_questions.first_step: Generalize the T74 audit_mixed.py to read the idle-axis overlay and rerun PR3148's release.
open_questions.blocked_by: No overlay reader in the T74 chain.

open_questions.question: Can the remaining 3.05e-8 to the R438 bit endpoint be closed?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The exact search is optimal over the legal single-axis move class; the residual is blocked by PR1252's commuting rule, not by search.
open_questions.first_step: Prototype a new move class (chained/relay donor swaps, or re-anchoring port axes outside the translation span) with the commuting rule strictly enforced, and check rank mass, the rank-51 cap and halving.
open_questions.blocked_by: No legal move class beyond single-axis donor moves is specified yet.

open_questions.question: Can the bit endpoint itself rise past R438?
open_questions.why_it_matters: kappa = min(complex, bit), so a lower R raises the ceiling directly.
open_questions.first_step: Test helper removals outside PR1043's pure-relay class (helpers read more than twice, helper merges).
open_questions.blocked_by: PR1043's lifetime test only certifies 2-occurrence relays; R438 depends on the open PR1043.
